<section class="nb-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" data-nb-tabs-content data-nb-tab-label="curl">

<p>This example grabs all links from the <a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/">Cloudflare Doc's homepage</a>.
The response will be a JSON array containing the links found on the page.</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">curl -X POST 'https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/&lt;accountId&gt;/browser-rendering/links' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer &lt;apiToken&gt;' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    &quot;url&quot;: &quot;https://developers.cloudflare.com/&quot;
  }'
</code></pre>

</section> <section class="nb-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" data-nb-tabs-content data-nb-tab-label="TypeScript SDK">

<pre><code class="language-typescript">import Cloudflare from &quot;cloudflare&quot;;

const client = new Cloudflare({
	apiToken: process.env[&quot;CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN&quot;],
});

const links = await client.browserRendering.links.create({
	account_id: process.env[&quot;CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID&quot;],
	url: &quot;https://developers.cloudflare.com/&quot;,
});

console.log(links);
</code></pre>

</section> <section class="nb-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" data-nb-tabs-content data-nb-tab-label="Workers binding">

<pre><code class="language-typescript">interface Env {
	BROWSER: BrowserRun;
}

export default {
	async fetch(request, env): Promise&lt;Response&gt; {
		return await env.BROWSER.quickAction(&quot;links&quot;, {
			url: &quot;https://developers.cloudflare.com/&quot;,
		});
	},
} satisfies ExportedHandler&lt;Env&gt;;
</code></pre>
